                             PAUL SKINNNER'S POST HEARING BRIEF

Paul Skinner, pro se intervenor, on behalf of himself, respectfully submits this post hearing

brief. Paul Skinner is a landowner to property impacted directly by one of the proposed

routes. His item number is 272.

Paul Skinner previously submitted testimony and exhibits that were admitted into the

record. Paul Skinner respectfully requests that the Administrative Law Judges consider the

admitted testimony and exhibits in their entirety.


Based upon the evidence admitted into the record, Paul Skinner opposes the

application in its entirety and respectfully recommends denial of the proposed

transmission line project.




                                                                    Post Hearing Brief of Paul Skinner
                                                                              PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                 SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349 Page
                                                                                                1 of 3
 As set forth in Paul Skinner's testimony and exhibits, the proposed project would negatively

affect Intervenor's property, agricultural activities, existing improvements, future plans for the

property, and continued use and enjoyment of the land. Those concerns are fully described in

the evidence already admitted into the record.

During the Hearing on the Merits on June 8, 2026, Intervenor Lazy B Land Company

(Benjamin Tanner) cross-examined Applicants' representatives, who admitted on the

record that Link G73 landowners within 500 feet of the proposed centerline were not

mailed notice prior to the 2025 public meetings as required by 16 Tex. Admin. Code §

22.52(a)(4) as it was a ·'new link" Specifically, during cross-examination of Applicants on

Monday, June 8, 2026, Benjamin Tanner asked, "A majority of link G-73 Landowners did not

receive mail notice of the project until late March, 2026, correct?" To which an applicant

representative replied, "Yes, since that was an added link, after public participation

meetings. That is Correct". Therefore, link G73 should not be considered due to lack of

proper notice. In the alternative, should the Commission approve the application despite

intervenor's recommendation for denial, Paul Skinner respectfully requests that the

Commission consider the alternate routes and continue to reject link G73 for the reasons

set forth therein.

                                                                              Respectfully Submitted,
